name: ReviewLatency
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — preview parameterization. The record's `ReviewLatency` defaults `buckets`, `medianH`, `loading` and adds loading/error states, so it renders standalone in a preview that mounts records with no props; the file's takes them as required props from its caller. Region-scoped check: the file's `ReviewLatency` holds 5 substantive line(s) the record lacks — under the 8-line threshold at which parameterization stops being a full explanation, so it is treated as explained. NOT zero, though: if this component ever gained behaviour the record missed, those 5 line(s) are where to look. Refreshing from the file would discard the parameterization. Written by scripts/reconcile-record-src.cjs --annotate.
whenUse: A histogram of PR review latency with a median callout.
whenNot: Fleet-wide time-to-land — use the fleet TimeToLand panel.
